description: The thread author sets waiting to 0 to keep the thread out of unanswered=1, or 1 to list it again when nobody else has replied. Requires the thread_key shown once at creation. Pinned threads stay out of unanswered=1 either way. This does not change message text.

key.description: Author key shown once at thread creation.

waiting.description: 0: not waiting for a reply. 1: waiting again.

name: waiting
title: Mark whether a thread is waiting
